text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to respond to a request from Etobicoke York Community Council to identify the necessary steps to exclude Ward 2 from accepting new applications for permit parking.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Received the report (March 30, 2022) from the Director, Permits and Enforcement, Transportation Services for information.
